facts: Notebook (feed): The Oaks opened their first NBA Cup run at home in front of a sold-out crowd and held off the Oklahoma City Thunder, 101-95, behind Dillon Brooks' biggest scoring night as an Oak. The Oaks led after every quarter but never by much: 35-30 after one, 63-60 at the half and 78-74 after a 15-14 third. Brooks played 39 minutes and scored 22 on 8 of 15, hitting 6 of 9 from three, with 4 rebounds, 5 assists, 2 steals, a block and one turnover. In a game this close, his threes kept Oklahoma City at arm's length. Adash Stanley added 21 and 6 assists and went 6 for 6 at the line, though he turned it over 6 times. Wendell Carter Jr. was nearly perfect, 8 of 9 for 19 points and 13 rebounds, and AJ Dybantsa ground out a 13-point, 10-rebound double-double on a 4 for 15 night. As a team the Oaks went 13 of 13 from the line. The Oaks move to 6-1 and 1-0 in Cup play.
Oaks — game-result (early-season), C114: Dillon Brooks' six threes carry the Oaks past OKC in the Cup opener. Oaks 101 - Thunder 95

Notebook (feed): The rout in Toronto gave the rest of the roster a night. T. Henderson Jr. scored 14 in 12 minutes on 7 of 10 shooting, T. Jerome put up 19 points, 7 rebounds and 7 assists, J. Valančiūnas added 8 on 4 of 5, G. Trent Jr. had 7 and B. Simmons 5. J. Champagnie handed out 6 assists in 20 minutes, and B. James Jr. got a minute at the end. Every Oak who played scored except James, and the only DNPs were J. Tate and Coen Carr.
Oaks — team-update (early-season), C114: Henderson, Jerome and the depth turn a rout into a showcase

After 13 minutes in Indiana he played 23 in Toronto and filled the line: 8 points on 3 of 5, 2 of 2 from three for the second game running, 5 rebounds, 3 assists, a steal and a block. Notebook (feed): After the perfect start ended in Indiana, the Oaks went to Toronto and answered with the most lopsided win in franchise history, Oaks 135 - Raptors 75, in front of a 95% crowd. The Oaks led 39-19 after one, 73-40 at the half and 101-62 after three, and nobody played more than 28 minutes. Austin Reaves led with 20 on 4 of 6 from three, T. Jerome had 19 points, 7 rebounds and 7 assists, and Adash Stanley went 4 for 4 from three for 16 with 7 rebounds and 6 assists. Wendell Carter
Oaks — game-result (early-season), C114: The Oaks bounce back with a 60-point rout in Toronto. Oaks 135 - Raptors 75

Notebook (feed): Five games in, rookie Harry Hayward is looking like a solid rotation piece. In 13 minutes in Indiana the second-round pick scored 8 points on 3 of 4 shooting, 2 of 2 from three, with 4 rebounds. It follows his 12-point night in Detroit and his 10-point, 10-rebound double-double in New York. Not bad for the name nobody talked about on draft night.
Oaks — player-feature (early-season), C114: Second-round rookie Harry Hayward is shaping up as a solid rotation piece

Notebook (feed): The Oaks' perfect start ends at four. In Indiana, in front of a building at 90% capacity, the Pacers built a 61-42 halftime lead behind a 34-point second quarter and led 82-62 after three. The Oaks answered with 38 points in the fourth and won the quarter 38-22, but the comeback came up four short, Pacers 104 - Oaks 100. Adash Stanley and Austin Reaves led the way with 19 apiece. Stanley hit 5 of 11 from three, and Reaves had 7 assists and 6 rebounds without a turnover. AJ Dyban
Oaks — game-result (early-season), C114: The Oaks storm back from 20 down in Indiana but the Pacers end the perfect start. Pacers 104 - Oaks 100
I'm still a bit worried about the Oaks, but their 4-0 start is really giving me hope.
